# Day 4 — Linear Algebra

Day 4 — Linear Algebra / Mission. Math covers matrix readings,
transformations, sampling distributions, and basic derivations.
Programming covers R housekeeping, data wrangling with dplyr and
tidyr, and the grammar of graphics with ggplot.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
